subject: Malaysia M-510 TiO2 for BEVEPE wall-paint formulations
body:
BEVEPE formulates decorative paints and small-batch private-label products; the AUTHENTIC WALL PRIMER sheet describes an acrylic wall primer.

We manufacture Malaysia-origin M-510 rutile TiO2. Its technical sheet lists water-based interior and exterior wall paints, with zirconium/aluminium surface treatment.

May I send the M-510 TDS for your purchasing and formulation teams' review?
